response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong open-source and developer-tooling background (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/DevOps, and prior C/C++ work on the LabWindows/CVI IDE), which shows genuine affinity for tooling and language ecosystems. However, the role's core requirements — deep JVM expertise, strong Java and Kotlin, and solid Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate enterprise framework experience — are essentially absent. Java appears only peripherally (robotic arms, a device orchestration tool, ~2016-2018) and Kotlin and Spring are never mentioned; the last decade of work is overwhelmingly TypeScript/Node.js and D. The gap between his primary stack and the JVM-centric responsibilities is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own enterprise-framework subsystems from day one.
strengths: Prior IDE internals experience (C/C++ on NI LabWindows/CVI)
Strong tooling/OSS track record: test runners, libraries, CI/CD, TDD
Broad, adaptable polyglot senior engineer with teaching/communication skills
concerns: No Kotlin and no Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience listed
Java experience is minimal, peripheral, and roughly 8 years stale
Recent decade centered on TypeScript/Node and D, not JVM systems
